document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
After a fruitless search through the twilit bush, you and your 
students return to camp, to find that the canoe has disappeared. 
Charlie is gone, and she has taken some of the supplies.

The students exchange a look. You struggle to hide your own 
dismay. You must be strong for their sake.
Record the keyword BAREFOOT. Go to 53.
